verdict.rationale: Mastra documents agent memory that stores message history (mastra-docs-22, mastra-docs-4). It also has Processors that "transform, validate, or control messages as they pass through an agent" (mastra-docs-33), which suggests you could filter or trim history. However, nothing in the pack ties these features to context-window management. missing for 10: explicit history trimming or last-N message limits, token-budget-aware truncation, summarization or compaction of older messages, documented filtering of tool results from history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
